title: Ella Day Tour — Nine Arch & Elephant Transit Home
seoTitle: Ella Day Tour | Nine Arch Bridge & Elephant Transit Home | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private Ella day tour from the west coast: Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Falls, and the Elephant Transit Home. Hotel pickup included.
shortDescription: A private highland day covering Nine Arch Bridge, Little Adam's Peak, Ravana Falls, and the Elephant Transit Home.
overview:
A private full-day journey into Sri Lanka's hill country, built around Ella's most loved viewpoints and a responsible elephant encounter at the Elephant Transit Home near Udawalawe.
Start with hotel pickup, then walk the iconic Nine Arch Bridge, hike Little Adam's Peak for tea-country panoramas, pause at Ravana Ella Falls, and continue to the Elephant Transit Home to watch orphaned calves at feeding time. Your chauffeur guide keeps the day flexible so photos, short walks, and rest stops never feel rushed.

highlights.title: Nine Arch Bridge
highlights.description: Walk the colonial stone viaduct above tea country. This is Ella’s signature photo stop — time on the bridge for viewpoints, and with luck a passing train. Stay alert on the tracks and follow your guide.

highlights.title: Little Adam’s Peak
highlights.description: A gentle hike to a ridgeline over Ella Gap, tea estates, and distant hills. Includes the walk up, time at the summit, photos, and the return — no technical climbing, just a steady trail.

highlights.title: Ravana Ella Falls
highlights.description: A roadside waterfall named in the Ramayana legend. Short stop for photos beside the cascade and a cool spray before the drive continues south. Not a long trek — a scenic pause.

highlights.title: Elephant Transit Home
highlights.description: Watch orphaned elephant calves at feeding time near Udawalawe. This is a government conservation centre, not a riding or bathing camp. Admission is paid on site and is not included in the tour price. Feeding slots are fixed, so the day’s pacing is built around the visit.

highlights.title: Private hotel pickup and drop-off
highlights.description: Your chauffeur guide collects you from your hotel — typically Kalutara, Colombo, or nearby west-coast stays — and returns you in the evening. Tell us your hotel when you book so we confirm pickup time.

itinerary.title: Ella highlands & Elephant Transit Home
itinerary.description: Morning hotel pickup, then a scenic drive into Ella’s hill country. Walk Nine Arch Bridge, hike Little Adam’s Peak for tea-country views, pause at Ravana Ella Falls, and continue to the Elephant Transit Home near Udawalawe (admission not included). Evening return to your hotel.
highlights: Nine Arch Bridge — walk the viaduct and photo stop
Little Adam’s Peak — gentle hike and summit views
Ravana Ella Falls — roadside waterfall pause
Elephant Transit Home — calf feeding visit near Udawalawe (tickets extra)

faqs.question: Is this a private tour?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Ella day tour is private for your group, with your own vehicle and chauffeur guide.

faqs.question: Is Elephant Transit Home admission included?
faqs.answer: No. ETH tickets are paid on site and are not included in the tour price. Other optional entrance fees, lunch, and personal expenses are also excluded.

faqs.question: Where does the tour start?
faqs.answer: Hotel pickup and drop-off are included, typically from Kalutara, Colombo, and nearby west-coast hotels. Tell us your hotel when you enquire so we can confirm timing.

faqs.question: How are prices calculated?
faqs.answer: Rates are for a private vehicle and guide: 1 traveler $240, 2 travelers $330, 3 travelers $420, 4 travelers $510, 5 travelers $600, and 6 travelers $690 in total. Online booking prices 1–6 guests; for 7 or more, choose 7+ or WhatsApp us for confirmation.
